generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The Contractor should quote the item wise rates Excluding GST.
All terms and conditions as per NIT and KW4

The bidders shall upload the work done certificate for having executed One building work of value not less than Rs. 169.50 lakhs and completed satisfactorily as a prime contractor within stipulated time period in the past 5 years (i.e., F/Y 2021-22 to 2025-26). Work done certificate shall be duly signed by the officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer or equivalent.

The bidders shall upload the work done certificate of for minimum quantities of work executed in any one year for following quantities (In a continuous period of 12 months from April to March) in the last 5 years (i.e. F/Y 2021-22 to 2025-26) the certificate shall be issued by the officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer or equivalent. a.PCC/RCC - 662.00 Cum b.TMT steel reinforcement - 38.00 Tonnes c.Burnt brick masonry/Solid block masonry - 508.00Cum / 2540.00 Sqm d.Vitrified / Ceramic / Granite flooring 1365.00 Sqm
The bidders shall upload a valid registered KPWD Civil contractor Licence of Class II and above.

The bidders shall achieved turnover for an amount not less than Rs. 678.00 lakhs achieved in any two financial years in the past 5 years (i.e. F/Y 2021-22 to 2025-26) (in all classes of civil engineering construction works only). The Turnover certificate along with Balance sheet and P & L statement of past 5 years for the Civil Engineering works only (i.e. F/Y 2021-22 to 2025-26) issued from a Registered Chartered Accountant (Registered Chartered Accountant PIN and UDIN number must be mentioned failing which bid will be considered as Non-Responsive) should be uploaded.

The bidder/tenderer or his identified Sub contractor should have executed similar Water supply / sanitary engineering works /PHE works totalling for Rs. 6.48 lakhs in any one year in the last 5 years, (i.e. F/Y 2021-22 to 2025-26) signed by the officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer or equivalent for Water supply / sanitary engineering works /PHE works.

The banker certificate pertaining to Liquid Assets for availability of fund requirement for the work not less Rs.102.00 Lakhs issued by Nationalised / Scheduled Bank for the subject work addressed to General Manager (Civil), Corporate office, BESCOM after 31.10.2026 in the enclosed format.

Bidders who meet the above specified minimum qualifying criteria, will only be qualified, if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value. The bidder shall upload his tender capacity calculation in his letter head along with date and signature with Seal as per the formula Assessed available tender capacity (AxNx1.50-B) Where, A Maximum value of civil engineering works executed in any one year during the last five years updated to 2026-27 price level taking into account the completed as well as works in progress. N Number of years prescribed for completion of the works for which tenders are invited. B Value, at 2026-27 price level, of existing commitments and ongoing works to be completed during the next 12 Months.

Bidder shall upload the self-declaration affidavit as per the enclosed format on the stamp paper of value not less than Rs. 500/- duly notarized stating that a.Not made any misleading or false representations in the forms, statements and attachments submitted in proof of the qualification requirements.b.Not made any Record of poor performance such as abandoning the works, not properly completing the contract, inordinate delays in completion or financial failures etc.c.Not participated in the previous Tender for the same work and had quoted unreasonably high tender prices and could not furnish rational justification.d.No Litigation History or arbitration arising out of contracts completed or under execution by it over the preceding five years.
